description: Static site waitlist form that submits to Cloudflare KV, calculates network valuation, and reveals valuation only to users committing >50GB storage

priorLessonsConsulted.summary: Cloudflare Workers KV provides built-in key-value storage with no external dependencies
Form validation should happen at the edge (Worker) to prevent bad data and reduce origin load

userStories.title: Waitlist signup with storage commitment
userStories.description: As a potential contributor, I want to sign up for the waitlist with my email, hardware type, and storage commitment so that I can be notified when the network launches
acceptanceCriteria: AC1 — Form displays email field, hardware dropdown, and storage commitment slider (1GB-1TB)
AC2 — Form validates email format before submission
AC3 — Form submits via POST to Cloudflare Worker endpoint
AC4 — Worker validates input and rejects malformed requests with 400 status
AC5 — Worker stores user record in KV user:{email}
AC6 — Worker updates aggregate stats in KV
Typecheck passes
All validators pass
userStories.notes: All ACs complete. Switched from Redis to Cloudflare KV for built-in storage.

validationProof.e2eVerified: curl tests show user storage and stats accumulation

userStories.title: Network valuation calculation
userStories.description: As the network operator, I want the system to calculate network valuation based on total committed resources so that I can track growth
acceptanceCriteria: AC1 — Valuation formula: (total_storage_gb * 0.10) + (total_compute_tflops * 50) + (user_count * 100)
AC2 — Valuation stored in KV after each signup
AC3 — Valuation formatted as $X.XK or $X.XM or $X.XB for display
Typecheck passes
All validators pass
userStories.notes: All ACs complete. Valuation verified: $10.9K for 4 test users matches expected calculation.

userStories.title: Conditional valuation display
userStories.description: As a high-commitment contributor (>50GB), I want to see the network valuation after signup so that I understand the network's worth
acceptanceCriteria: AC1 — Worker returns valuation in response ONLY if storage_commitment_gb > 50
AC2 — Worker returns 'hidden' status for users with storage_commitment_gb <= 50
AC3 — Site displays valuation with animation when returned
AC4 — Site displays 'Commit 50GB+ to see network value' message for low-commitment users
Typecheck passes
All validators pass

userStories.title: Security and rate limiting
userStories.description: As the network operator, I want the form to be protected against abuse so that the system remains stable
acceptanceCriteria: AC1 — Worker has CORS configured for site domain only
AC2 — Worker rate limits to 5 submissions per minute per IP
AC3 — Worker hashes IP for duplicate detection without storing raw IP
AC4 — Duplicate email submissions update existing record rather than creating new
Typecheck passes
All validators pass
